name: api-bench
description: Dry-run how an application would call the Claude Messages API or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint before writing the app. One JSON spec carries the system prompt, seed messages, tool schemas, stubbed tool results, and hard request, token, and dollar caps; the helper runs the tool-use loop, records the exact transcript, and compares variants. Credentials stay in the environment, mock runs need no network, and nothing is committed or edited.
